name: AppBar
description: A material design app bar that displays at the top of the screen. It typically contains a title, navigation icons, and action buttons.

properties.name: title
properties.description: A widget to display as the app bar's title, usually a Text widget.

properties.name: leading
properties.description: A widget displayed before the title, often an IconButton for navigation.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: Widgets displayed after the title, typically IconButtons for actions.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The background color of the app bar.

properties.name: elevation
properties.description: The z-coordinate of the app bar, affecting the shadow size.

properties.name: centerTitle
properties.description: Whether the title should be centered. Defaults depend on platform.

properties.name: automaticallyImplyLeading
properties.description: Whether to automatically add a back button or menu button when appropriate.

properties.name: bottom
properties.description: A widget displayed at the bottom of the app bar, usually a TabBar.

properties.name: toolbarHeight
properties.description: Height of the toolbar portion of the app bar.
